identification: Box of common maritime and general books. Titles read: Space (modern large hardback), reproduction Bangor Daily Commercial Titanic extra (souvenir reprint), Mariotti lighthouse book (modern), The Last Tall Ships (Kahre, Conway, 1978 era, common), Flexible Metallic Tubing trade catalogue, Douglas Combined Protractor and Parallel Rule instruction folder (protractor may not be inside), And Now All This (Sellar and Yeatman, Methuen 1932, torn jacket). No title on the list is a book worth real money under the book rule; the Sellar and Yeatman is the only possible one (first edition in jacket, a few tens of dollars even so, torn jacket lowers it).
